name: voice
description: Full-duplex local voice: Claude speaks through piper-voice, a local streaming text-to-speech service on Piper (127.0.0.1 only), says its replies with /speak on, and hears you with /listen, transcribed on this machine by whisper.cpp (listening is Windows only and off until /listen)

language.title: Language
language.description: fr or en: the language whisper transcribes, Piper speaks (its voice, unless the voice option or PIPER_VOICE_VOICE picks one) and every message is written in. The spoken commands are understood in both (Top Claude / Hey Claude, Claude pause, Claude arrête d'écouter / Claude stop listening)

autoSend.title: Send each sentence heard
autoSend.description: On: each sentence heard for Claude is sent as a prompt at once. Off (the default): it waits in the prompt box until you press Enter

whisperStream.title: whisper-stream.exe
whisperStream.description: The path of whisper.cpp's whisper-stream.exe. Empty: found on PATH, else under %LOCALAPPDATA%\voice-listen

whisperModel.title: Whisper model
whisperModel.description: The path of a ggml-*.bin model. Empty: the first under %LOCALAPPDATA%\voice-listen\models, large-v3-turbo first

voice.title: Piper voice
voice.description: A piper-voice voice id. Empty: en_US-ljspeech-medium for en, fr_FR-siwis-medium for fr, or the service's default when PIPER_VOICE_VOICE sets one

callApp.title: Other voice agent's app
callApp.description: The process name of another voice agent whose call shares the microphone (by default the ChatGPT app): while its call's mic is open, what you say goes to it, and its voice is not taken for yours. Empty turns this off

sceneSayFile.title: 3D scene say file
sceneSayFile.description: Off when empty (the default). A file a 3D scene reads: while its Godot window has the focus, Claude's replies are written there for its own voice instead of piper-voice
